testcase.name: provider opens real Flutter Documents media and rejects sibling or write access

api bands select scoped or legacy storage without broad permission
414 parser accepts one PDF to open and refuses PDF to photos
actual handler preserves successful sibling when a later save rolls back
busy gate permits one operation and ignores late release
414 provider types PDF and the view intent grants read only
share intent is ordered read-only and truthful for one and many
parser rejects malformed envelopes and busy is ordered per input
provider rejects a symlinked literal root when creating and opening URI
414 open presents once, holds busy until resume, and reports no viewer
fresh actual handler sweeps only exact legacy staging markers
partial rollback publication and restart sweep are causally invocation scoped
actual handler drives api28 permission busy and one shot completion
